source.excerpt: Customers can cancel new or packing orders. Customers cannot cancel shipped orders. We have not decided whether support can override this.
source.authority_evidence: Synthetic fixture: the designated owner made this decision directly.

claim.statement: Customers may cancel new or packing orders, but cannot cancel shipped orders.
claim.scope: Customer cancellation of an order in new, packing, or shipped status.
claim.condition: Evaluate the order status when cancellation is requested.
claim.outcome: Allow new and packing; deny shipped.
questions: Can support staff override the customer restriction? Outside this rule's customer scope.

examples.given: Customer requests cancellation of a packing order.
Customer requests cancellation of a shipped order.
